_format: PROPOSED to the UI & cinematics chat (owner of content/cutscenes and the tool). Shots carry lensMm (35mm-film equivalent), move, framing, blocking, beats, durationSec and optional dialogue refs (script#line), audio, lighting and film cues. The last shot is the gameplay blend.
logline: The city at dusk, the Flatiron's prow, a man standing where he used to stand his post. Then up Broadway.

shots.move: slow crane down from roof level of the Met Life tower toward Madison Sq Park
shots.framing: Wide; WTC towers tiny on the downtown horizon left; sun low behind New Jersey
shots.blocking: Park benches with sleepers; traffic streaming down Fifth
beats: Streetlights flicker on along Broadway, one by one
audio: city bed: horns, a bus kneeling, a radio from an open window (Night Owl Radio jingle)
shots.lighting: dusk key from the west, sodium lamps warming up

shots.framing: The Flatiron's prow centred, Broadway and Fifth splitting behind it
shots.blocking: A small figure on the sidewalk at the north tip, hands in pockets (Teddy)
beats: A cab cuts through frame; its brake lights flare

shots.framing: Teddy from the waist up, the prow's limestone behind
shots.blocking: Teddy checks his watch, looks up Broadway
shots.lighting: last sun on the building's west face, his face in shadow

shots.framing: His hand turning the Saint Christopher medal through his shirt
beats: Tells the player: he's a man with a habit and a past

shots.framing: Over Teddy's shoulder toward Fifth Ave; a big man crossing against the light
shots.blocking: Mayhew enters from the Fifth Ave side, sport coat over his arm, waving
beats: Mayhew's grin before he's close enough to talk

shots.framing: Both men, prow between them and the evening sky
shots.blocking: Mayhew stops a little too close; Teddy doesn't step back

shots.move: camera pulls back and swings behind Teddy to the gameplay rig, matching world.json spawn heading (north up Broadway)
shots.blocking: Mayhew starts walking uptown; Teddy follows
beats: HUD fades in with the objective 'Walk up Broadway with Mayhew'
film: reel-change language not used here; a continuous blend
